crystalReports.title: Crystal Report Manager
crystalReports.subTitle: Create, version, download, and control access to Crystal report files.
crystalReports.createHint: Choose a supported business entity and upload the first immutable Crystal report version.
crystalReports.importExistingHint: Reports already deployed in approved Crystal entity folders. Summary Information is read automatically.
crystalReports.importSuccess: Existing Crystal report imported as draft version 1.
crystalReports.importError: Unable to import this existing Crystal report.
crystalReports.catalogError: Unable to load the existing Crystal report catalog.
crystalReports.noExistingReports: No existing Crystal reports match this search.
crystalReports.noSupportedEntities: No supported report entities are available.
crystalReports.entitiesLoadError: Unable to load the supported report entities.
crystalReports.entityKeyHint: Use the owning entity key, for example countries. The server validates the file naming rule.
crystalReports.fileHint: Only .rpt files up to 10 MiB can be selected. The server performs final validation.
crystalReports.summaryInfoHint: The report name and subject are read automatically from Crystal Report Summary Information.
crystalReports.revalidationError: Unable to revalidate this stored report version.
crystalReports.publishRequiresValid: Publishing is available only after this exact version is valid against the current contract.
crystalReports.archiveConfirm: Archive report "{{name}}"? Existing versions remain auditable.
crystalReports.accessReadOnly: You can view access assignments, but cannot change them.
crystalReports.permissionDenied: You do not have permission for this report action.
crystalReports.uploadError: Unable to upload this report revision.
crystalReports.rolesLoadError: Unable to load roles for report permissions.
crystalReports.conflictReloaded: This report changed in another operation. The latest server version has been reloaded; review it before trying again.

globalTemplates.title: Global Report Manager
globalTemplates.conflict: This report changed. Its latest state has been loaded; review it before retrying.
globalTemplates.publishHint: Uploading adds an immutable version. The published version changes only when you publish a valid version.
globalTemplates.registrationHint: Select a report already present on the Crystal service to register it as draft version 1. Registration does not publish it.
globalTemplates.subject: Subject
globalTemplates.invalidCatalogResponse: The server returned an empty or incompatible report catalog. Refresh after publishing the matching ERP API.
globalTemplates.registrationUnknown: Registration status unavailable from this server version
globalTemplates.connectionError: Unable to read the server response. Check connectivity and whether CORS allows this application origin.
globalTemplates.maximumRoleGrants: A report can have at most 100 assigned roles.
globalTemplates.accessHint: Grant each role its explicit rights. Company users need their entity and reporting permissions too. Upload and Publish never grant global administration by themselves.

design.title: New empty template
design.hint: Choose a module and approved data source, then design the report in Crystal Designer.
design.sourceHint: Choose the approved field structure, then select a matching database View below. The binding is fixed after creation.
design.tooLong: The value exceeds the allowed field length.
design.keyFormat: Enter a non-empty value; report keys use lowercase English letters, digits and single hyphens.
design.keyPrefix: The report key must equal the source key or start with the source key followed by a hyphen.
design.keyHint: Example: countries-directory. A key already reserved by an active or archived report cannot be reused.
design.requiredParameter: Required parameter; preserve the declared values and type.
design.instructions: Download the designer package, extract it, create a Blank Report in Crystal Designer, and connect to the XSD using ADO.NET (XML). After designing, upload the RPT to this draft.
design.draftHint: This creates an empty, unpublished template record. It contains no RPT until you upload the design. A matching deployed report key is reserved immediately.
design.noSources: No approved data sources are available with your current permissions.
design.created: The empty template was created. Upload the design as its first version.
design.emptyVersions: No design uploaded yet. Prepare the report in Crystal Designer and upload version 1.
design.viewHint: Enter schema.ViewName manually. The View must use WITH SCHEMABINDING, approved global ReferenceData tables and the exact fields shown below.
design.viewFormat: Enter a two-part SQL View name, for example dbo.vw_Countries.
design.viewCatalogHint: Choose a database View matching the selected structure. Unavailable choices show their validation reason.
design.noViews: No database Views match this source or search. Create a compatible View in the source database, then refresh.
design.viewLoadError: Unable to read database Views. Try again.

viewReasons.ContractMismatch: The View does not match the approved fields or its metadata cannot be verified

globalTemplates.replaceConfirm: Report “{{name}}” already exists (published version: {{version}}). Replace and publish will inspect this file, save a new version and switch publication to it. Previous versions and report permissions will be preserved. The previous version remains published if replacement fails.
globalTemplates.replacedAndPublished: The new report version was saved and published. Previous versions are preserved.
globalTemplates.replacementUnavailable: This report already exists. Replacement requires an active report and both Upload and Publish access. Open its details to review the report.
